snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 3, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

Kicking off our Episode 3 translated playthrough! 

Similar to Episode 1, you can give the kids gifts to increase their friendship during Free Time! We'll be translating their gift dialogue in a separate video. You can also buy a special item in the Gift Shop to use during the mini attraction! Must be a nice way for Yu-sensei to relieve some stress.

The dialogue with Hayate is different based on how you respond. Find those responses and dialogue if you don't get enough points from the first time you challenge Whack-A-Froggy-Egg here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-qQJ9kVWemQ

Thank you for watching, demi!

--

Episode 3 - The Divided Children

The children have watched their friends fall to devastating Game Overs, one after another. In response, they split into two teams: the "Wolf Team," which is determined to collect medals on their own and escape, and the "Goat Team," which works together to gather medals and try to escape as a group...

Okada Yu works hard to collect medals with the Goat Team. Meanwhile, the Wolf Team, having left the Rest Area, discovers a new attraction called "Merry-Go-Circuit." Okada decides to join them, unwilling to let them face it alone. As Okada's belief in "helping each other to escape together" begins to crumble, various trials await them at Merry-Go-Circuit.

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Yu Okada, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with the kids. As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly gets distorted... they wander into the deserted amusement park "Uropia" where they're confronted by a cute but creepy creature called "Froggy Egg." In order to return to their own world, they must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 "medals"...

--
